years_of_experience.instructions: How many years of professional technical experience does the resume demonstrate? Use only explicit evidence.

technical_depth.instructions: Rate hands-on engineering depth using personally owned project evidence. Ignore job titles and keyword lists.
criteria: Deep specialist with broad technical ownership

mentorship_demonstrated.instructions: Does the resume explicitly demonstrate mentoring, technical leadership, or teaching other engineers?

llm_experience.instructions: Does the resume explicitly demonstrate building or operating products using large language models or generative AI?

open_source_experience.instructions: Does the resume explicitly demonstrate open-source contributions or maintenance?

primary_talent_profile.instructions: Which primary technical profile is best supported by the resume evidence? Do not infer from job title alone.

criteria.frontend_engineer: Builds user-facing interfaces and frontend systems
criteria.backend_engineer: Builds server-side services, APIs, data models, and backend systems
criteria.full_stack_engineer: Owns both user-facing interfaces and backend services
criteria.devops_infrastructure: Owns CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, reliability, or platform systems
criteria.data_engineer: Builds data pipelines, warehouses, and data platforms
criteria.ml_ai_engineer: Builds, evaluates, or serves Machine Learning or AI systems
criteria.security_engineer: Works on application, cloud, infrastructure, or product security
criteria.other: Technical profile does not fit the listed categories
criteria.unclear: The resume does not provide enough evidence

career_progression.instructions: What career progression pattern is explicitly shown by the resume?

criteria.lateral_moves: Similar technical roles across different organizations
criteria.unclear: Progression cannot be determined from the evidence
